children: of ITS, a Baltimore-based assessment technology provider specializing in the management, delivery, and reporting of testing programs. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
The transaction will integrate ITS into Pearson Professional Assessments, expanding a commercial partnership established in 2009.

The deal enhances Pearson’s global verification capabilities by incorporating ITS’s enterprise software, broadening its suite of digital testing solutions to include remote proctoring, performance-based evaluation, and continuous certification programs.

"This acquisition strengthens Pearson's role as verified skills and assessment infrastructure and supports our long-term assessment strategy," said Art Valentine, president of Assessment & Qualifications at Pearson.
